question.en: Why is Tim finding this trip exciting?
question.zh: 为什么蒂姆觉得这次旅行令人激动？

sentences.en: Why is Tim finding this trip exciting?
sentences.zh: 为什么蒂姆觉得这次旅行令人激动？

sentences.en: I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚收到弟弟蒂姆的来信。

sentences.en: He has been there for six months.
sentences.zh: 他在那儿已经住了六个月了。

sentences.en: He is working for a big firm and he has already visited a great number of different places in Australia.
sentences.zh: 他正在一家大公司工作，并且已经去过澳大利亚的不少地方了。

sentences.en: He has just bought an Australian car and has gone to Alice Springs, a small town in the centre of Australia.
sentences.zh: 他刚买了一辆澳大利亚小汽车，现在去了澳大利亚中部的小镇艾利斯斯普林斯。

chunks.x: to Alice Springs a small town in the centre of Australia

sentences.zh: 他不久还将到达达尔文。

sentences.en: From there, he will fly to Perth.
My brother has never been abroad before, so he is finding this trip very exciting.
sentences.zh: 我弟弟以前从未出过国，因此他觉得这次旅行非常激动人心。
